decisionRuleMapping.mechanical: the pre-committed rule requires n >= 8 clean pulls after exclusions; n = 5 (strict R3 reading) or 6 (lenient pull-8 inclusion) - below the bar either way. The judge's carried risk flag anticipated exactly this on a short recording containing a chain collapse.
decisionRuleMapping.informational: had n sufficed: median T = 11.6 (strict) / 11.25 (lenient). Under the amended +-1.45 tolerance both land only in the H1/H1b window [8.94,11.84). Under the packet's original +-0.35 windows both land in T >= 10.74 (H-band). The n-independent counting bound (floor ~11.1) sits above the original H1 window in every variant. No verdict is attached; the encoding question (H1 vs H1b) is additionally out of reach because sub-steps never resolve.
